# Whale lights (vendored)

`whale-drones.json` is an unchanged copy of
`codewhale-design/whale/out/whale-drones.json`, generated from source hash
`c281468862e8bdc5bc894dcafa5ff5d1997152abf177e4a0426ffec3ab62576c`.
The hero uses its generated launch lattices, constant radius and minimum
physical-pixel pitch. Motion follows `codewhale-design/whale/MOTION.md`.

The older `whale-lights.json` remains the unchanged 64-bead reference from
`codewhale-app/assets/whale-lights.json` at
`55c9ba0c95368accca78ca36d9b86a3fd7ce4253`, used by `web/lib/whale-lights.ts`.
Its SHA-256 is
`529b8d0f70113c8aa1153e28e596c263b1df69cbc04e268b15d04da8445e3e15`.

Re-copy generated assets from their owning source; do not edit their geometry
here. The hero is an illustration of the ready formation, not an indicator of
an observed session. CPU usage needs measurement on the reference Mac before
claiming compliance with the kit's 5% budget.
